-- fs --
work/alpha/file
work/beta/file
work/a.txt
work/.hidden/file
-- script --
start /work
size 28 5
option dirsonly true
option hidden true
option quote false
snapshot directories-only
reject a.txt
press down enter
state chosen /work/alpha
press tab
state filter alpha/
snapshot only-files
press enter
state chosen /work/alpha
press shift+tab
press end enter
state chosen /work/beta
